minimal_production_components: Evidence Pack Builder + Source Graph Validator

evidence_thresholds.command_minimum: L3 + L4 + L5 jointly per action (narrow reviewed donor-exception only)
evidence_thresholds.validation_command_minimum: L3 + L5, plus L4 where compatibility/version behavior affects validation

allowed_root_classes: PURL-derived native registry root (DERIVED_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY, typed ops only)
dependency-coordinate-derived native registry root (only when parsed from anchored metadata)
runtime-derived URLs from image/container evidence (e.g. TOMCAT_TGZ_FALLBACK_URL)
promoted upstream docs/release-note/security roots (via deterministic promotion rules)
runtime-vendor docs parented to runtime identity
forbidden_root_classes: metadata homepage/scm/bugs/docs links as auto-authority (candidate-only until corroborated)
deps.dev links as final artifact authority
third-party mirrors/blogs/forums with no package-authority path
llm_allowed_roles: reason about upgrade/closure tradeoffs within the pack
draft Patch Form suggestions from retrieved evidence
propose command/validation_command only at L3+L4+L5 threshold
propose human-review notes for risky compatibility moves
llm_forbidden_roles: create source roots or invent domains
emit commands below the evidence threshold
mark remediation verified (no AFTER scan / re-exploit / evaluation claims)
human_gate_responsibilities: review per-action suggestions and evidence citations
approve, edit, or reject; own final confirmation
validator_responsibilities: check per-field evidence linkage (uncited non-UNKNOWN field = fail)
check command/validation_command presence rules (null when blocked)
evaluation_responsibilities: final remediation classification (remediation success vs failure)
